about: Same experiment: no p-values because every condition has one sample.
question: Why are there no p-values in my report?

model.content:
Each condition has one sample, so no statistics are possible: the comparisons are fold change only, with no p-values [issue:FOLD_CHANGE_ONLY] [analysis:comparisons].

Treat the candidates as leads to confirm [help:issue.FOLD_CHANGE_ONLY].
